mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_img, a.view_count, a.comment_count, a.like_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y年%m月') AS yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS articleCount FROM blog_article WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article ( user_id, category_id, title, content, summary, cover_img, status, is_top, view_count, comment_count, like_count, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{coverImg}, #{status}, #{isTop,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category_id = VALUES(category_id), title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), summary = VALUES(summary), cover_img = VALUES(cover_img), status = VALUES(status), is_top = VALUES(is_top), update_time = NOW()
